skills.description: Using a smart mirror or fixed camera, the system analyzes high-resolution adult facial images or short videos to detect physiological features such as under-eye bag area (puffiness/shadow under the lower eyelid), dark-circle grayscale (darkness around the eyes), mouth-corner drop angle (angle between corner of mouth and horizontal), and glabellar frown lines (vertical lines between the brows), and computes a comprehensive fatigue/stress index (0-100). Application scenarios: smart mirrors, office health displays, smartphone selfie apps, personal health management. skills.description: Altium Designer (AD) PCB设计工程师专属技能。当用户提到 Altium Designer、AD、PCB设计、原理图绘制、PCB布局布线、封装库创建、铺铜、3D模型、DRC检查、Gerber输出、FPGA设计、或任何电子设计自动化(EDA)相关操作时，应激活此技能。涵盖从原理图设计到PCB制造输出的完整工作流程，包括快捷键速查、操作步骤指引、设计规则配置、库管理及输出文件生成。
skills.description_zh:
在内电层用 Place > Line 画分界线
双击分割区分配网络
重建: Tools > Split Planes > Rebuild Planes
DRC检查: Split Plane DRC (Broken Planes / Dead Copper / Starved Thermals)
5. 3D功能
进入3D: 按 3，恢复2D: 按 2
旋转: Shift + 鼠标右键
水平放置: 0，翻转: V+B
导入STEP: Place > 3D Body from STEP Model
STEP版本: 203(无颜色) / 214(支持颜色)
旋转模型: 数字键盘 2/8(X轴), 4/6(Y轴), 空格/Shift+空格(Z轴)
导出STEP: File > Save As > Export STEP
MCAD交互: 支持IDF导入导出
6. 设计规则与DRC
设计规则: Design > Rules

一元型规则(Unary): 约束单个对象(线宽等)
二元型规则(Binary): 约束两个对象集关系(间距等)
查询语言定义范围，Query Builder辅助构造
优先级管理: Increase/Decrease Priority
DRC检查:

在线DRC: Tools > Preferences > General > Online DRC
批量DRC: Tools > Design Rule Check > Run Design Rule Check
错误定位: PCB面板Rules模式 / Messages面板 / DRC报告
7. 设计输出
Output Job文件: File > New > Output Job File

F9: 批处理运行，SHIFT+F9: 运行当前，CTRL+SHIFT+F9: 运行选中
Gerber: 格式2:3/2:4/2:5
NC Drill: 格式2:3/2:4/2:5
ODB++: 选择层输出
BOM: Reports > Bill Of Material，支持Excel模板
SmartPDF: File > SmartPDF
装配变量: Project > Assembly Variants
8. 多通道设计
必须使用层次分级方式(Hierarchical)
复用表达式: Repeat(PB, 1, 4; Switch.Sch)
Room格式复制: 源Room → 目标Room
板级标注: Tools > Re-Annotate
9. FPGA设计
OpenBus设计: File > New > Other > OpenBus System Document
约束文件: Design > Add/Modify Constraint > Port/Part
构建流程: Compile → Synthesize → Build → Program FPGA
虚拟仪器: 频率发生器(CLKGEN)、逻辑分析仪(LAX_x)等
FPGA到PCB: Tools > FPGA To PCB Project Wizard
管脚交换: Tools > Pin/Part Swapping
快捷键速查
详细快捷键参考: 加载 references/keyboard_shortcuts.md

核心快捷键：

快捷键	功能
G	循环切换捕捉栅格
Q	公制/英制切换
L	打开层和颜色对话框
SPACEBAR	旋转/切换导线角度
SHIFT+SPACEBAR	改变导线/布线弯折模式
TAB	编辑放置对象属性
F11	Inspector面板
SHIFT+F12	List面板
SHIFT+C	清除过滤器/Mask
CTRL+SHIFT+V	智能粘贴
PT	交互式布线
PP	Place > Part
*	切换布线层(自动加过孔)
SHIFT+R	切换布线冲突解决模式
3 / 2	3D/2D显示切换
SHIFT+S	单层显示模式
END	刷新屏幕
VD	显示整个文档
VF	适应所有对象
网络标识范围
范围	说明
单层(Sheet)	端口跨所有原理图；网络标号本地化
全局(Global)	端口和网络标号都跨所有原理图
层次(Hierarchical)	图纸入口/端口纵向连接；网络标号本地化
自动(Automatic)	有图纸入口→层次；有端口→单层；都无→全局
常见问题与解决
同步错误 - 缺少封装: 检查元件是否有PCB封装模型，确认库已安装
同步错误 - 引脚不匹配: 在PCB模型对话框中用Pin Map定义映射
DRC间距冲突: 检查设计规则优先级和查询范围
铺铜不连接: 确认Connect to Net设置，检查Pour Over选项
自动布线失败: 确保Keep Out层有封闭区域，设计规则正确，布线层方向已设定

library_management.md — 库编辑完整指南(原理图库、PCB封装库、集成库、DBLib、参数管理器、模型管理器)
keyboard_shortcuts.md — 原理图+PCB完整快捷键速查表

skills.description: Using a fixed camera in the classroom or above the home desk, the system analyzes the child's (student's) facial video in real time, detecting eye closure ratio (PERCLOS — the proportion of time eyes are closed more than 80% within a unit time), head-nodding frequency (rapid downward nod followed by lift), and changes in eye-region glossiness, and computes a comprehensive fatigue index (0-100). The skill helps teachers or parents detect drowsiness in time and adjust learning schedules or remind the child to rest. Application scenarios: classrooms, home desks, online classes. The system monitors in real time and, when the fatigue index exceeds a threshold, pushes reminders or triggers voice prompts (e.g., 'kid, time to take a break').
